name: Amp
tagline: Coding agent for terminal, web, macOS, and iOS that can run threads in hosted orbs.
description: Amp runs a coding agent in the terminal, browser, or native apps, either locally or in per-thread cloud machines called orbs. It includes specialist subagents, MCP support, and cross-client thread continuation.

pricing.notes: Hobby tier is free with pay-as-you-go orbs and BYOK; Individual is $20/month with included usage.
